title: Calloway's offer at the Adams Theater and the uniform tailor
summary: Chu Berry tells him Calloway wants him; at the Adams Theater in Newark Calloway hires him, and the band's uniforms come free from the tailor Carnik.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: -- we were back there where you, Don's band was getting a little seedy and you was in Ohio and Cab --
Cab? No. Cab -- I come back home --
-- from the trip. No. From the trip I came back to New York.
Yeah, from the trip to Cleveland.

And Choo Choo Berry was sitting in the lobby. So Choo Choo Berry told me, he said, 'Say, Brother,' he said, 'Calloway wants to see you.' And I said, 'Yeah?' And he said, 'Yeah,' he said, 'come over to the Adams Theater tomorrow.'
That's over in Newark, New Jersey?

Uh-huh. So I come over to the Adams Theater and talked to Calloway and Calloway said, 'How'd you like to join my band,' he said, 'after all these years? I tried to get you before.' He said, 'Now, do you want this job?' You know?
And I said, 'Sure I'll take this job.' And he told

me the salary and everything and he told me, he said, "You go to [Carnik] and get measured for your uniform," you know, and so forth and so forth, "and you give me the itinerary of the band." I said, "What?" I never had anything like this before, you know. And I said, "How much the uniform's going to cost me?" because I used to have to buy the uniform in Don's band.
"It shouldn't [cost] you nothing," you know. He said, "You go to [Carnik] and measured up for a uniform and meet me in Springfield on the 8th."
